about.title: About us
about.description: Villa Venere is a beautiful sea-view villa near the beaches and center of Cetara. It offers three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a comfortable living room, an equipped induction kitchen and a panoramic terrace overlooking the Tower and Port. The villa also has private access to the sea.
